name: conclave
description: Connect Codex and private ChatGPT cloud access to the existing Conclave WSL MCP server for memory, project context, plans, health and policy-routed proposals.

interface.longDescription: Use your Conclave workspace from Codex, with optional private ChatGPT access through a dedicated OpenAI tunnel. Search and read memory, resolve project context, inspect plans and health, request approvals and propose policy-routed memory updates. The existing WSL server owns its credentials and policy. Approval requests never authorize execution; eligible memory proposals may commit automatically.
defaultPrompt: Check Conclave health and summarize the current plan.
Find Conclave memory relevant to this task and cite the records.
Resolve Conclave project context before planning my next change.
